Install Astryx globally
Install the Astryx CLI once for your computer with npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, or Volta, and what happens when you are
offline.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

install                Install it - Install the CLI package with your package manager. One astryx command then works in
                       every folder.
eacces                 Permission denied (EACCES) - If `npm i -g` fails with `EACCES`, do not use `sudo`. Give npm a
                       global folder you own, then add its `bin` folder to your PATH, or use a Node version manager such
                       as nvm, fnm, or Volta:
versions-for-projects  Versions for your projects - When a project's own CLI is installed but cannot start, Astryx runs
                       the CLI version equal to the project's Core instead, installing it once into a cache in your home
                       folder and reusing it. It uses npm for that, so your npm registry,...
offline                Offline - Your global install answers offline in a project with only Core, and so does any
                       project that installs its own CLI. Outside a project, commands that read components, such as `npx
                       @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Button`, need your global version's Core:...
more                   More on global mode - This page is part of `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global`, which
                       explains what global mode is and how each part works. Next: `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs
                       global/who-answers`.

Read one section: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global/install-once <section>
Read everything:  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global/install-once --full
